paper_metadata.title: Effect of 2 wt% Ti addition on high-temperature strength of fine-grained, particle dispersed V–Y alloys

evidence.quote: fine-grained, particle dispersed V–Y alloys, a V–1.7Y–2.1Ti (in wt%) alloy was fabricated by powder metallurgical (P/M) methods.
the observed increase in the normalized yield strength for V–1.7Y–2.1Ti is attributable to solution-hardening by Ti.
The results were compared with those of V–(1.7–2.4)Y and V–4Cr–4Ti (NIFS heat-1) alloys.
They were mixed to provide the nominal composition of V–1.7Y–2.1Ti (in wt%) in a glove box filled with a purified Ar gas (purity 99.99999%).
The results were compared with those of V–(1.7–2.4)Y and V–4Cr–4Ti (NIFS heat-1) alloys.
MA treatments were conducted by a planetary ball mill for 50 h in a purified Ar (purity 99.99999%) atmosphere.
HIP was conducted at 1273 K and 200 MPa for 3 h in an Ar atmosphere.
All of the specimens were wrapped with Ta foil and then Zr foil and annealed at 1273 K for 1 h in a vacuum better than 5 · 10^-5 Pa.
